args.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` defaulting to `http://localhost:3000` (`src/notifications/templates.ts`), which causes links in production emails to point to localhost instead of the configured application domain.
